Name: Xiddav's Buildable Greenhouse with Upgrades
Author: xiddav
Description:
A greenhouse that can be built by Robin after unlocking the main Greenhouse.
The new greenhouse can be upgraded 3 times.

This mod does not change the main Greenhouse.

base: 9x9 dirt plot
upgrade 1: 15x11 dirt plot
upgrade 2: 19x19 dirt plot
upgrade 3: 19x19 dirt plot + 20 single plots for wild trees


The prices are configurable, but it is Money and Wood.
The default is rather cheap. To build and fully upgrade costs 38,000 money, 1,100 wood and 50 hardwood.
Each upgrade takes 2 days for Robin to complete.

The building uses the games greenhouse appearance, so any recolors that change the greenhouse exterior will effect the buildable greenhouses exterior.
